assets.description: Exactly one simple persimmon-orange round paper lantern with a neat cap and a short single hanging tassel, viewed straight on. Very compact and recognizable silhouette, no string beyond the silhouette.
Exactly one simple mint turquoise-green round paper lantern with a neat cap and a short single hanging tassel, same scale and outline as the orange one, viewed straight on. Compact and recognizable.

One child-friendly miniature bubble car seen from straight overhead. Oriented to the right, pale apricot body with warm cream circular roof and two chunky slate-green wheels visible; near-square silhouette.
One copy of the little overhead apricot bubble car facing right, now with a small pale mint circular nozzle visibly open at the front. Same scale and silhouette, no external bubble or motion trail.
One glossy amber toy glass marble, round and legible at small scale, with one simple pine green inner leaf swirl and a cream highlight, no ground shadow.
One compact apricot lotus-shaped festival lantern with folded cream and mint paper petals and a thick warm cream sticker edge. Original cut-paper souvenir; no other subject.
